Hi team,

We're the operations team handling hold DP-99821. The acquirer's alert referenced a VAT mismatch: the billing address on the merchant's invoices does not match the VAT registration country on file. For physical goods/services supplied to EU customers, we need either:

- a VAT registration certificate showing the billed supply address, OR
- a clear statement of place of supply with supporting contracts/POs that demonstrate intra-community supply rules.

Separately, because the payment pattern triggered an SCA/3DS failure on that card, the acquirer flagged the settlement for additional verification. If Acme can provide a signed cardholder consent to accept the charge (and confirm the charge details), that helps our case but is not always sufficient alone.

Recommended evidence bundle to submit to Stripe: vat-certificate-acme.pdf, invoice-ACME-202704.pdf, a signed consent form, proof of delivery/contract (if available). Upload via: https://dashboard.stripe.com/disputes/DP-99821 and reference merchant: redwood-inference / ACME-4732.

We will fast-track review once the bundle is uploaded, but note that if the acquirer already processed a reversal, the time window narrows. If you want us to submit on your behalf, grant permission and we can attach the docs to the case.

Regards,
